description: This file defines the RemoteBridge class which implements cross-process communication in an Electron application. It manages window controls, backups, keychain access, media permissions, and file backups, exposing these functionalities to other parts of the app.

classes.name: RemoteBridge
classes.description: Implements cross-process communication for Electron, managing window controls, backups, keychain, media permissions, and file backups, exposing these functionalities via the exposableValue property.

methods.name: exposableValue
methods.description: Returns an object exposing various methods and properties for cross-process communication.

methods.name: extServerHost
methods.description: Gets the external server host URL from the store.

methods.name: useNativeKeychain
methods.description: Determines if native keychain is used, defaulting to true.

methods.name: rendererPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the renderer script.

methods.name: isMacOS
methods.description: Checks if the operating system is macOS.

methods.name: isWindowMaximized
